description: Inland container depots and dry ports by country from the UN/LOCODE code list: locations flagged as multimodal (function 6) that are not seaports, with their rail and road functions, subdivision, status and coordinates. Optionally include multimodal seaports or filter by name. Data is the UN/LOCODE list as mirrored on DataHub (ODC-PDDL); it marks facilities, it does not report operators or capacity. Choose this tool for: Inland container depots and dry ports by country. Close alternatives on this server: logistics_carnet_ata_status (ATA Carnet country check from the International Chamber); logistics_container_tracking (Shipping container number check: validates an ISO 6346). Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

country.description: Two-letter country code, e.g. IN, TR, DE

includeSeaports.description: true to also list multimodal locations that are seaports (default false)

q.description: Optional: part of the location name
